newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aurora says gold output up, cost down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aurora says gold output up, cost down.

text.p: Aurora Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it produced more gold at a lower cost at its Mount Muro mine in Kalimantan, Indonesia, in the fourth quarter of 1996 than in the previous quarter
Gold production of 54,629 ounces and silver production of 1.027 million ounces took equivalent gold output to 67,898 ounces for the fourth quarter versus 61,481 ounces in the previous quarter.
Cash operating costs over the same period fell to an average US$199.00 an ounce from US$213.00, the company said.

Aurora also said it has recorded encouraging exploration results from a series of prospects at Mount Muro and has upgraded the resource at its Toka Tindung project in North Sulawesi, owing to the discovery of an inferred resource of 129,000 ounces of gold at the nearby Batupangah prospect.

The discovery of the Batupangah deposit was strategically important, as it may provide a relatively high-grade ore feed within trucking distance of a proposed gold treatment plant at Toka Tindung, Aurora said.
Also, the deposit was open along a strike and down dip, indicating the potential for similar adjacent gold vein systems in the area, the company said.
